instructions:
Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.
Write the correct letter in boxes 21 and 22 on your answer sheet.

Choose TWO letters, A-G.
Write the correct letters in boxes 23 and 24 on your answer sheet.

items.prompt: What does the writer say about the summer internship?

options.text: Students may apply for it once they have graduated
A new group of interns is taken on twice a year
It may be taken by students who have just finished their first year
It is intended mainly for students of economics

items.evidence: Cedarline Financial Services offers a ten-week summer internship each year to undergraduate students entering their second or final year of study.

distractor_analysis.A: Kapsam kaydirma -- program lisans OGRENCILERINE aciliyor (A metni A/1); secenek hakki mezun olmuslara tasiyor.
distractor_analysis.B: Sayi kaydirma -- staj yilda bir kez, yaz doneminde aciliyor ('each year', A metni A/1); secenek bunu yilda iki gruba cikariyor.
distractor_analysis.D: Cazip ama yanlis -- bir finans sirketi soz konusu oldugu icin en akla yatkin gorunen secenek bu, ama metin uc alani esit sayiyor: 'economics, accounting or business studies' (A metni A/2). Hicbiri otekinin onune konmuyor.

items.explanation: Paragraph A of Text A says the internship is offered to undergraduate students entering their second or final year, so a student who has just completed a first year is eligible.

yeniden_uretim.kaynak_prompt: GT2 okuma - isaretli kalem elden gecirme (2026-08-18)
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: What does the writer say about the graduate programme?
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Interns complete a short performance review at the five-week mark and a final review before departure; strong performers may be invited to apply for the graduate programme the following year, though this is not guaranteed and depends on business need.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Iki gerekce. (1) Butce ihlali: kalemin kaniti (A metni D/2) tablo tamamlamanin 20. kalemiyle ORTAKTI, yani tek bir cumlede iki soru vardi; 'bir kanit cumlesinde en cok 1 soru' kurali asiliyordu. (2) Kalan kip riski: cumlenin kendi hedge'i ('not guaranteed... depends on business need') dogru secenegin ifadesiyle ortusuyordu, secenek kesin dile cevrilmis olsa bile ayni cumleye bagliydi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Yuva ayni metnin bos bir cumlesine tasindi: kanit D/2'den A/1'e (kimlerin basvurabilecegi) gecti; D paragrafi artik yalniz 20. kaleme ait, cumle cakismasi kalkti. Genel kultur bilerek YANLIS secenege capalandi: bir finans sirketinde stajin 'aslinda ekonomi ogrencileri icin' oldugu sezgisi D'ye goturuyor, oysa metin uc alani esit sayiyor. Kip dengesi: olculu iki secenegin (A, C) biri dogru, kesin iki secenegin (B, D) hicbiri dogru degil; 22. kalemle birlikte sette olculu 3 secenegin 1'i, kesin 5 secenegin 1'i dogru.

revision.onceki_prompt: What does the writer say about the graduate programme?

onceki_secenekler.A: Any intern can apply for it after the placement
onceki_secenekler.B: It takes on fifteen graduates across the departments
onceki_secenekler.C: An invitation to apply depends partly on company needs
onceki_secenekler.D: It begins soon after the internship comes to an end

revision.ne_degisti: Kip ters yone cevrildi: dogru secenek C'nin olculu ifadesi ('depends partly on') kesin bicime getirildi ('are tied to what the business needs'), buna karsilik A ve D olculu kipe cekildi ('any intern can' -> 'interns may', 'begins soon after' -> 'is likely to start'). Artik olculu yazilan iki secenek de yanlis, kesin yazilan iki secenegin biri dogru; 'olculu = dogru' imzasi kalkti.

items.prompt: What does the writer say about applying to work remotely?

options.text: The final say rests with the HR team
A request can be refused because of what the applicant's team needs
Employees who deal with clients are barred from applying
Successful applicants may work remotely on four days a week

items.evidence: Employees who have completed their probationary period may apply to work remotely for up to three days per week, subject to line manager approval and the operational needs of their team.

distractor_analysis.A: Cazip ama yanlis -- calisma duzeni degisikliklerinin IK'da karara baglandigi yaygin bir is dunyasi beklentisi, ama metin onayi acikca amire birakiyor: 'subject to line manager approval' (B metni A/1). IK yalnizca kalici konum degisikliginde ve yurt disi izninde geciyor (B metni D).
distractor_analysis.C: Cazip ama yanlis -- musteriyle calisanlarin uzaktan calisamayacagi sezgisi guclu, ama metin bu rollerin YASAKLANDIGINI degil, ofise daha sik cagrilabilecegini soyluyor: 'may be required to attend the office more frequently' (B metni A/2).
distractor_analysis.D: Sayi kaydirma -- ust sinir haftada uc gun (B metni A/1); secenek bunu dorde cikariyor.

items.explanation: Paragraph A of Text B says that applications to work remotely are subject to line manager approval and to the operational needs of the team, so the team's needs can be a reason for refusal.

yeniden_uretim.kaynak_prompt: GT2 okuma - isaretli kalem elden gecirme (2026-08-18)
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: What does the writer say about staff who deal directly with clients?
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Staff in client-facing roles may be required to attend the office more frequently regardless of general policy.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: E7 2/2 parcasiz olcumunde uc turun ucunde de dogru bilindi, dayanak acikca general_knowledge. Sorunun ekseni 'musteriyle calisanlar ofise daha sik gelir' onermesiydi ve bu, herhangi bir sirket yonergesi okunmadan da bilinen bir is dunyasi gercegi. Secenekleri dengelemek ekseni degistirmiyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Yuva ayni paragrafin bir ust cumlesine tasindi (B metni A/2 -> A/1) ve soru 'kimin ofise gelmesi gerekir'den 'basvuru nasil karara baglanir'a cevrildi. Genel kulturun iki guclu magneti (kararin IK'da olmasi, musteriyle calisanlarin yasakli olmasi) bilerek YANLIS seceneklere -- A ve C'ye -- capalandi; dogru secenek B, metnin kendi kaydina ('the operational needs of their team') bagli. 23-24 kalemiyle secenek ortusmesi olmamasi icin D, oradaki celdiricilerden farkli bir ayrinti (gun sayisi) uzerine kuruldu. Kip dengesi: kesin uc secenegin (A, B, C) biri dogru, olculu tek secenek (D) yanlis. Dogru harf 21. kalemle ayni olmasin diye B'ye alindi (21 = C, 22 = B).

revision.onceki_prompt: What does the writer say about staff who deal directly with clients?

onceki_secenekler.A: They may need to spend more days in the office
onceki_secenekler.B: They are not allowed to work remotely at all
onceki_secenekler.C: They need approval from HR as well as a manager
onceki_secenekler.D: They are given extra money for home equipment

revision.ne_degisti: Dogru secenek A metnin kendi 'may be required' kalibini birebir yankilamayacak bicimde yeniden yazildi ('may need to spend' -> 'can be asked to come in'), celdiricilerden C olculu kipe cekildi ('need approval' -> 'might also need'), D ise kesin bicimde birakildi. Yeni dagilim: olculu 2 secenegin 1'i dogru, kesin 2 secenegin 0'i dogru. GT2 setinin tamami icinde (21 ve 22 birlikte) olculu 4 secenegin 1'i, kesin 4 secenegin 1'i dogru -- set duzeyinde kip dengelenmis oldu.

items.prompt: Which TWO statements about the remote working policy are correct?

options.text: Staff may work remotely as soon as they join the company
Remote working arrangements are all reviewed every six months
The company pays for the internet connection used at home
Employees may work from abroad if their manager agrees
Home-office claims usually go through the line manager
Everyone must spend at least one day a week in the office
Any change to someone's remote days needs a week's notice

items.evidence: Remote working arrangements are reviewed every six months and may be withdrawn if performance or availability standards are not met. Requests to change remote working days must be submitted at least one week in advance.

distractor_analysis.A: Kapsam kaydirma -- uzaktan calisma basvurusu deneme suresini tamamlamis calisanlara acik (A/1); ise baslar baslamaz degil.
distractor_analysis.C: Ters yon -- en az 10 Mbps'lik baglantiyi calisanin kendisi saglamak zorunda (B/2); sirketin verdigi sey dizustu bilgisayar.
distractor_analysis.D: Kapsam kaydirma -- yurt disindan calismak icin hem IK'dan hem ilgili ulke ofisinden ayri yazili onay gerekiyor (D/2); amir onayi tek basina yetmiyor.
distractor_analysis.E: Yer degistirme -- onayli ev ofisi ekipmani icin geri odeme masraf sistemi uzerinden isteniyor (B/5), amir uzerinden degil.
distractor_analysis.F: Cazip ama yok -- haftada bir gun ofiste bulunma zorunlulugu metinde yok; yalniz musteriyle calisan rollerin daha sik cagrilabilecegi soyleniyor (A/2).

items.explanation: Paragraph C of Text B says remote working arrangements are reviewed every six months, and that requests to change remote working days must be submitted at least one week in advance.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Which TWO things must remote employees do?
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Be available on instant messaging during core hours. Employees must designate a single working location for remote days and notify the HR team in advance if that location changes for more than two consecutive weeks, for insurance and tax purposes.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Sorunun ekseni uzaktan calisma politikalarinin standart maddeleri: cekirdek saatlerde ulasilabilir olmak (B) ve kalici konum degisikligini IK'ya bildirmek (D) bu tur politikalarda neredeyse her zaman bulunur. Secenek dengelemesi bu ekseni degistirmez.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Yuva bosaltilip ayni metinden yeni bir soruyla dolduruldu. Eski soru B paragrafinin ucuncu maddesi ile D/1'e dayaniyordu: cekirdek saatlerde ulasilabilir olmak ve kalici konum degisikligini IK'ya bildirmek. Uzaktan calisma politikalarinin neredeyse hepsinde bulunan iki madde oldugu icin B+D ikilisi metne bakilmadan seciliyordu. Yeni soru o iki cumleye hic degmiyor: kanit C/2 ve C/3'e tasindi. Kurgu GT1'deki ile ayni: en tanidik uc madde (deneme suresi olmadan uzaktan calisma, internetin sirketce odenmesi, amir onayiyla yurt disi) celdirici yapildi; dogru iki secenek sirkete ozgu iki keyfi sureye baglandi (alti aylik gozden gecirme, bir haftalik bildirim). Konumsal duzen icin harf cifti B+G; boylece bu calistirmadaki bes iki-harfli yuvada A, B, C, D, E, F, G harflerinin hepsi en az bir kez dogru oluyor ve hicbir cift tekrarlanmiyor.
